obligations.description: There is an unconditional one-clock magnitude register per lane. At every rising edge with reset inactive, form unsigned32-bit magnitudes of the CURRENT selected multiplier operands: left is interpreted signed only for current function21 or23, right only for current function21. For a negative signed operand its magnitude is its32-bit two-complement negation; otherwise it is unchanged. Register the unsigned64-bit magnitude product every clock, even when input valid0, not accepted, or the elastic pipeline stalls. Reset clears this register0. The combinational corrected product P uses that registered magnitude with the CURRENT live operand-sign parity, not saved sign bits: negate it modulo2^64 when current signed-left-negative XOR signed-right-negative is1. Stage1 saves function/addend on accepted input. When stage1 advances into stage2, use its saved function f and saved32-bit addend c, but P from the currently visible magnitude/sign history: if f[4:2]=binary110 (both24..27 and56..59), result is low32(P+c) for exact f24/26, otherwise low32(c-P). For exact f21/22/23 return P[63:32]. All other f return P[31:0]. Arithmetic wraps at its stated width. The free-running magnitude and live sign correction remain observable under changing invalid/stalled inputs; do not replace this behavior with an ideal transaction-only multiplier.

obligations.description: Maintain stage1 valid v1 and stage2 valid v2, reset0. Let Xready=!scalar_FIFO_full OR outx_ready; Vready=!vector_FIFO_full OR outv_ready. Sink readiness R is Xready when saved stage2 scalar-write flag1, otherwise Vready, regardless of stage2 valid or vector flag. Native in_ready is NOT(v1 AND v2 AND NOT R), with no reset gating. Each rising edge outside reset: if in_ready, v1 becomes current in_valid; otherwise hold v1. If NOT v2 OR R, v2 becomes old v1; otherwise hold v2. Accept/save input payload exactly when in_valid AND in_ready. Advance/save stage2 result and metadata exactly when old v1 AND (NOT old v2 OR R). Each saved payload holds when its own enable is false, even when its valid clears. With both FIFOs available, an input accepted at E reaches stage2 after E+1 and its result FIFO after E+2; there is no combinational FIFO fall-through.
